name: Camp Wekeela
description_short: Overnight camp in Hartford, Maine, for about 280 campers ages 7-16 per session. Families can choose a seven-week full session, a first or second session, or (for first-time campers only) a two-week rookie session. There are separate Kids Camp, Teen Camp (grades 7-9) and Leadership in Training (10th grade) programs.
activities: Whitewater rafting trip (Second Session Teen Camp)
Community service trip to Puerto Rico (LIT first session)
special_needs_notes: The camp is nut-aware and offers special-diet meals for campers with dietary restrictions. It has a separate Food Allergies page.

warnings: Each session shows two prices with no label, probably a crossed-out price and a discounted one. Session prices are left blank. The pairs are: Full Kids $15,900/$15,200; Full Teen $16,900/$16,300; LIT Full $17,900/*$16,300; LIT First $11,700/'Pricing coming soon'; LIT Second $10,100/'Pricing coming soon'; First Kids $9,500/$8,800; First Teen $10,700/$10,000; Second Kids $9,100/$8,800; Second Teen $10,100/$9,800; Rookie Kids $5,900/$5,500; Rookie Teen $6,600/$6,200.
The LIT full-session price 'May Change Based on added Multiple Overnight Trips'.
The White Plains shuttle dates (June 25 and Aug 10, 2027) don't match the session dates (June 24 to Aug 8). Confirm travel dates with the camp.

Optional programs cost extra: ice skating $75/lesson, horseback riding $190/lesson, golf $50/trip, surf $180/trip, graphic design $50/session. Transportation also costs extra: BOS $220 one-way/$385 round-trip; PWM $160/$285; White Plains shuttle $285/$525; private car to BOS $775, to PWM $325.
Payment terms: $2,000 deposit per camper with enrollment, further payments due Dec 1 and Mar 1, balance due May 1. Credit card payments carry a 2.90% + $0.30 fee.
The page footer says © 2017, but the dates match the 2027 calendar.
